about: The site's fonts: OFL placeholders (BRIEF.md §3, Type), at most two families per theme, about 60-80 KB per theme. Each comes from its Fontsource npm package at the pinned version, Latin subset (Basic Latin, Latin-1, general punctuation), as WOFF2. Run `node tools/fonts/fetch.mjs` after editing; it rewrites public/fonts/ and the @font-face block in src/styles/fonts.css. Jon swaps a font here and in that file's tokens.
